t: Asking while admitting you might not deserve it
a: ٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ وَٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ وَٱلْقَـٰنِتِينَ وَٱلْمُنفِقِينَ وَٱلْمُسْتَغْفِرِينَ بِٱلْأَسْحَارِ
p: Rabbanā innanā āmannā fa-ghfir lanā dhunūbanā wa qinā ʿadhāba-n-nār.
m: Those who say, "Our Lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire," The patient, the true, the obedient, those who spend [in the way of Allāh], and those who seek forgiveness before dawn.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
